title: The index of published Sprout worlds
description: What the Playdate app's download screen fetches. `signed` is the lower-case hexadecimal Ed25519 signature, made by the publisher's key, over the canonical text of `worlds`: no spaces, object keys in order, strings as JSON.stringify writes them, integers in decimal (scripts/index-signing.mjs `canonicalText`; sprout-player/Source/canonical.lua). The app reads nothing in the index before that signature verifies.

address.description: An http or https address, or one relative to the index's own address.

bytes.description: The size of the cartridge file.

hash.description: The bundle hash: the world's identity (the spec's The compiler > What compiling produces), the `hash` in the cartridge's header.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the cartridge file's bytes.

assets.description: The files beside the cartridge, in its `.assets` folder.

path.description: Relative to the assets folder, with `/` between parts and no `..`.
